pages.title: Scimitar Cat
pages.text: The scimitar cat ($(o)Homotherium latidens$()) is an extinct sabre-toothed cat that lived across Europe and Asia during the Pleistocene.$(br2)Its upper canines were shorter and broader than those of $(o)Smilodon$(), flattened and serrated like a scimitar blade. It had long forelimbs and a back that sloped down towards the hips.$(br2)A mummified cub around 35,000 years old has been found preserved in the Siberian permafrost.
